primitives.name: Game Outcome Predictor
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## BUILD 1 — Game outcome predictor (his model, fully specified) His words: NFLverse 2018–present, XGBoost, features = QB efficiency / explosive play rate / turnover margin / pass rush / point differential / player availability, adjusts for roster changes, 10,000 Monte Carlo sims.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathbb{P}(\\text{win})': 'dimensionless probability', 'w_i': 'model weight for feature i', 'f_i^{\\text{team}}': 'team value of feature i', 'f_i^{\\text{opp}}': 'opponent value of feature i'}
primitives.assumptions: Features are stationary, differentials capture relative strength, model is trained on historical game outcomes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Null when any feature is non-finite or missing.

layer2.mapping: XGBoost estimator maps feature differentials to binary game outcome posterior.
layer2.telemetry: Monte Carlo simulation convergence and calibration error.

primitives.name: Highlight Reel Detector
primitives.verbatim_quote: Model: extend the GBM scaffold in `packages/prediction-engine/src/ml-estimator.ts` — it is the repo's XGBoost-concept port (additive stumps, logistic link) and already carries the honesty gates (min sample size, staleness, feature-schema hash, fail-closed nulls).
primitives.assumptions: Audio and visual cues are temporally aligned, noise thresholds are statistically derived.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Returns null if audio/video input is invalid or feature extraction fails.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of audio energy spikes and commentary triggers mapped to event likelihood.
layer2.telemetry: Detection recall and false positive rate on labeled highlight clips.

primitives.name: Player Value Assessor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method: `valuePerDollar = totalEPA / capHitMillions`. Rank within position group; flag top-decile as surplus, bottom-decile as overpaid.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\text{totalEPA}': 'total expected points added', '\\text{capHitMillions}': 'salary cap hit in millions USD', '\\text{valuePerDollar}': 'EPA per million USD'}
primitives.assumptions: EPA is a valid proxy for player contribution, salary data is accurate and up-to-date.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Excludes players with zero or negative cap hit from ranking.

layer2.mapping: Value metric maps EPA to financial efficiency, enabling salary-based strategic decisions.
layer2.telemetry: Percentile rank consistency across position groups and salary tiers.

primitives.name: 4th Down Decision Grader
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method: for the current game state (down/distance/field position), score candidate plays by historical EPA/play of that play-type vs that defensive look (from nflverse, already ingested). Return top 3 with expected EPA and the defensive tendency each exploits.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\text{expectedEPA}_{\\text{play}}': 'expected EPA for a given play', '\\text{EPA}_{\\text{play}, j}': 'historical EPA for play type j', 'P(\\text{defensiveLook}_j | \\text{state})': 'probability of defensive look j given game state'}
primitives.assumptions: Historical EPA data is representative, defensive tendencies are stable over time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Returns null if no defensive data is available for the current state.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of play-type vs defensive look combinations yields optimal 4th-down recommendations.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of recommended plays vs actual outcomes in similar game states.
